description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Order made under Section 71 of the Colombo Port City Econamic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, outlining legal frameworks for granting exemptions and incentives to businesses. It establishes regulatory requirements, specifies which laws do not apply, and creates a statutory instrument under existing legislation, making it clearly a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
